summary.text: Greg Leding of Fayetteville represents District 30 in the Arkansas Senate, which includes most of Fayetteville; his first Senate term began in 2019, and in 2025 he began his second term as Senate Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Before the Senate, Leding served in the Arkansas House of Representatives from 2011 through 2018, representing House District 86, and was House Minority Leader for one term.
A native of Springdale, he has a degree from the University of Arkansas Sam M. Walton College of Business.
